verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is presented as an open-source, self-hosted crawling library with "no forced API keys, no paywalls." The evidence shows no paid plan, monthly credits, or request quotas, so the question of overage charges versus a hard cutoff does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the pack suggests a hosted metered tier that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
